title: I Left the Deli Review With the Wrong-Name Ticket Photo

parts.text: I posted the review at 1:16 p.m. with the ticket that said HALE and the bag that said someone else. Counter lead June said names were atmosphere. I was thirty-five, lunch regular, standing in a line that made me look like I owned the wait. The ticket said TURKEY ON RYE. The bag was egg salad. I photographed the ticket, the bag, and the number on the board. Then I left the still in the review they asked for. June laughed until the owner asked for the photo. The next bag matched. June name-dates the tickets now. A ticket is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.

social.description: Turkey on rye, egg salad bag, a number on the board. The owner asked for the photo. Has a counter ever served the other name?
